mo_ta_cong_viec:
Ready to kickstart your career in Cybersecurity before graduation? We are looking for motivated final-year students who want hands-on experience in building strong security systems within a security-first environment.
What You’ll Experience
Monitor and triage security alerts from SIEM/EDR and other security tools.
Assist in investigating security events and potential incidents.
Collect and analyze logs from systems, networks, and security platforms.
Support incident response activities and documentation.
Participate in security improvement initiatives (e.g., logging, monitoring, hardening).
Collaborate with IT teams (Infrastructure, Network, Helpdesk, DevOps, AI, … to implement security best practices.
Assist in deploying, configuring, or tuning security tools.
Maintain documentation for security processes and findings.
 
Why This Internship?
Gain hands-on experience in real-world security operations and incident response.
Learn how security is implemented across infrastructure, systems, and cloud platforms.
Collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to cutting-edge security projects.
Contribute to security improvement initiatives while building practical cybersecurity skills
yeu_cau:
Final-year student or recent graduate in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.
Basic understanding of networking, operating systems, and fundamental cybersecurity concepts.
Familiarity with security monitoring concepts, logs, or common security tools is a plus (e.g., SIEM, EDR).
Strong curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and security concepts.
Resilient mindset with the ability to work through challenges and handle pressure in a fast-paced environment.
Proactive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to take on new challenges.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical teams.
